title: King Most High
firstLine: From the earth from the sky

lines: From the earth from the sky
Breaks forth the joyful cry,
"Our Lord is King most high!"
Crucified, ...He revived,
That's why he's King most high.
Humble birth held no worth
Till angel voice sang forth,
"A King is born this day!"
Then the earth was aware
Its hope had come to stay.
Words He gave me to say,
By works He led the way -
This Lord and King to be.
Then alone, blood atoned,
His life he gave for me.
Darkest power He overcame,
Life for me He regained;
A prophet never to die;
Priest forever on His throne:
Lord, God my King most high.
My Lord is great and good,
And He will hear my cry;
He'll ever live and ever reign,
My Lord and King most high.
